The Ministry of IT & Telecommunication is seeking a single, accountable partner to establish and operate a centralized 24x7 Security Operations Centre that continuously monitors security telemetry from the Ministry’s data centres and connected federal entities, detects threats quickly, and executes disciplined incident response over a three-year MDR term that is extendable based on performance. We understand that “success” is not only deploying tools, but creating an operational capability: a SIEM/SOAR-enabled SOC with tiered L1/L2/L3 coverage, clear SLAs for time-to-detect and time-to-respond, actionable reporting, and sustained knowledge transfer so Ministry staff can govern and mature the service.

We also understand the environment is high-stakes: public-sector availability, confidentiality, and sovereignty requirements demand high-integrity logging, retention, and forensic readiness (evidence preservation, repeatable runbooks, and escalation paths), alongside proactive controls such as threat intelligence enrichment, continuous use-case tuning, and threat hunting.

TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd is ISO 27001 certified, which aligns with the Ministry’s mandatory requirement for an information security management framework [CO-PROFILE]. Our recent federal delivery footprint includes cloud infrastructure deployment [CAP-012] and cybersecurity deployments including a provincial government engagement [CAP-049] and multiple multi-month cybersecurity deployments up to PKR 143M in value [CAP-013].

We note two mandatory eligibility areas where our evidence library does not yet meet the RFP thresholds: our documented average annual turnover is PKR 900M (not PKR 1,200M) [CO-PROFILE], and our library does not yet evidence CISSP/GIAC (or equivalent) certifications across all SOC tiers [CO-PROFILE]. We will address these through an explicit subcontracting/consortium arrangement for eligibility and by staffing the SOC with appropriately certified resources prior to mobilisation, with credentials submitted for approval during contract kick-off.
